sourceSentences: [0] You win level one guys. It's Jinx Braum. If they go in, just block the hook. Fight.
[0] But you can counter the the the nautilus. If you counter the nautilus, you are fine.
[1] We're about to hit level two. So, I'm like, okay, la walk up. And then I already have the Braum stacks on me, which is a problem.
[1] This is why we would have had that kill if she didn't get stuck by the Braum passive.
[2] Braum is strong in melee combat, not to mention his (P) that allows him to counterplay, his overall tankiness, and his (E) to protect his allies and mitigate damage.
[2] Nautilus will have a hard time if he engages recklessly.
[2] However, Nautilus can counterplay when Braum charges in by rooting him with [P] while using [Q] to either retreat or engage accordingly.
[3] Braum is tricky to play into. If you fail your engage he has a lot of options to lock you down, so be careful.
[3] The other problem is that he can soak a lot of damage using his E. Play around his E cooldown and you should win the lane.
[3] Braum will protect his Adc in lane, making it quite difficult to make kills happen, but whenever you have a choice of hooking him or his Adc aim for the Adc.
[3] This way you will either hit the Adc or Braum who will have jumped to them with his W to either dodge or block your hook.
[3] Your Ult will not be blocked by his shield.
[4] Nautilus’s Dredge Line(Q) has a pretty good range.
[4] Reaching level 2 is important when facing off melee champions. Focus on leveling during level 1 to reach level 2 before your enemies!
